# A `sngl:` URI addresses a package everywhere a positional argument is
# taken, not only in `sngl doc`. It used to reach os.Stat and fail as a path.

# dump, at the stage the issue was found on. A library package is handed back
# as the checker built it rather than re-checked as a document: gtk4.sngl
# imports sngl:internal/marks, which only lib source may.
sngl dump --stage checked sngl:platform/gtk4
stdout 'component GtkButton'
stdout 'component GtkLabel'

# The widget declarations are synthesized from introspection data and have no
# file on disk, so a path-based read could not see them even in principle.
# They are still source, which is what --stage parsed prints.
sngl dump --stage parsed sngl:platform/gtk4
stdout 'component GtkButton'

sngl dump --stage parsed sngl:ui/draw
stdout 'component canvas'

sngl dump --stage checked sngl:ui
stdout 'component button'

# check reports on the package as a whole.
sngl check sngl:ui
stdout 'sngl:ui: ok'

sngl check sngl:platform/gtk4
stdout 'sngl:platform/gtk4: ok'

# A package argument is the whole input: naming one does not also walk the
# current directory.
sngl check sngl:ui
! stdout 'main.sngl'

# Packages and paths mix in one invocation.
sngl check sngl:ui/draw main.sngl
stdout 'sngl:ui/draw: ok'
stdout 'main.sngl: ok'

# generate runs the pipeline over the package's own declarations.
sngl generate --lang go --platform gtk4 -o out sngl:platform/gtk4
exists out/model.go

# fmt rewrites files in place and a package has none, so it says so rather
# than failing as a missing path.
! sngl fmt sngl:ui
stderr 'fmt works on files'

! sngl fmt --check sngl:ui
stderr 'fmt works on files'

# The package set is the one the process can actually reach, and an unknown
# name lists it.
! sngl dump --stage checked sngl:nope
stderr 'unknown package "sngl:nope"'
stderr 'platform/gtk4'

# Only the sngl scheme names a package of source. A foreign one used to reach
# os.Stat and report the URI as a missing file.
! sngl dump --stage checked go:example.com/api
stderr 'only the sngl scheme names a source package'

! sngl check go:example.com/api
stderr 'only the sngl scheme names a source package'

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main {
    text(value="hello")
}
